integrity: The complete positive-diagonal weighted width formula and exhaustive minimizing-normal classification follow from a weighted chamber step-ray argument with strict Euclidean triangle equality. Previously published unweighted width and rank threshold are explicitly credited and excluded from novelty. Verification computations are finite checks, not a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only positive diagonal scales and intrinsic Euclidean widths of rank-k hypersimplex base polytopes. Earlier unweighted results are not new. The result does not concern ambient full-dimensional polymatroid independence polytopes or provide a polynomial-time subset-optimization algorithm. Weighted historical priority is best-of-knowledge.
title: Intrinsic Euclidean width of every positively diagonally scaled hypersimplex
